title: Run
description: A run record. Class-level properties describe the run's configuration/template. Instance-level properties describe the concrete execution (timestamps, agent, spawned objects).

scenario_id.description: [class-level] Identifier of the scenario this run executes against.

version.description: [class-level] Schema version of the run record format.

agent_id.description: [instance-level] Identifier of the agent executing this run.

started_at.description: [instance-level] UTC timestamp when the run began.

ended_at.description: [instance-level] UTC timestamp when the run concluded (absent if still running).

simulation_time_s.description: [instance-level] Total simulated elapsed time in seconds.

status.description: [instance-level] Current lifecycle status of the run.

random_seed.description: [instance-level] Seed used for stochastic elements during execution.
